mainEntity.name: Can I renovate my whole home in phases?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can renovate your home in phases, which can be a practical approach for managing budget, minimizing disruption, or spreading out the project over time. This might involve renovating a kitchen one year and bathrooms the next. Phased renovations require careful planning to ensure design consistency and efficient transitions between stages, avoiding rework. We can help you develop a master plan that allows for future expansion while maintaining a cohesive look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Phased whole-home renovations are possible to manage budget and disruption, but require careful planning for design consistency.
